name: spark
description: Spark — a zero-player programming game where bots author physics-priced spells

scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --test packages/engine/dist/test/*.test.js apps/cli/dist/src/*.test.js
scripts.test:web: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @spark/web
scripts.match: npm run build:packages && node apps/cli/dist/src/main.js run
scripts.demo: npm run build:packages && node apps/cli/dist/src/main.js run --seed 7 --replay replays/demo.json && node apps/viewer-ascii/dist/src/main.js replays/demo.json
